name: ff-qr-extension
description: Firefox extension that generates QR codes for the current page, links, images, and selected text.

scripts.icons: command -v rsvg-convert >/dev/null || { echo 'icons: needs librsvg (brew install librsvg)' >&2; exit 1; }; for s in 16 32 48 96 128; do sed 's/context-fill //' icons/icon.svg | rsvg-convert -w $s -h $s -b none -o icons/icon-$s.png || exit 1; done; echo 'icons: regenerated 16/32/48/96/128'
